brief.businessIdea: Faceless CRM — an AI-first CRM for solo operators and AI-first agencies who never want to see a contact record. Notes, calls and emails flow in; the system surfaces the next best action as a one-line nudge with a draft reply.
brief.targetMarket: Solo founders, indie consultants, micro-agencies (1-5 people) running on Gmail/Outlook + a notes app.
brief.additionalContext: Zero forms, zero pipeline stages, zero required fields. AI drafts the next reply; the user edits it.

notes: Solo consultants report abandoning HubSpot Free within 30 days due to manual data entry; they prefer WhatsApp follow-ups over structured pipelines.
Micro-agency owners complain that pipeline hygiene erodes after two weeks because their team forgets to update stages — workflow disruption is the #1 reason cited.
Existing competitors: HubSpot Free, Folk, Attio, Pipedrive. All require structured forms. Folk leans into Gmail integration but still asks for stages.
Market signal: r/sales and Indie Hackers threads report >40% CRM abandonment in <90 days for solo operators on $0-$30/mo plans.
Risk: BYOK + inbox read permission is a high-trust posture. Two design-partner candidates declined a 15-minute call when 'we will read your sent items' was mentioned.
Counter-signal: One founder said 'I have tried four CRMs, I would pay $50/mo for one that just drafted the reply for me' — opportunity for AI-drafted follow-ups.
Substitute: many solo operators use a single Notion database + Gmail labels as their de-facto CRM.

personas.name: Maya — solo growth consultant
personas.summary: Books 10-15 calls/week, lives in inbox, refuses to maintain pipeline stages.

personas.name: Dev — 4-person AI agency owner
personas.summary: Wants accountability without nagging the team; tried HubSpot, Folk and Notion CRMs in 6 months.

assumptions.statement: Solo operators will pay $30+/mo if the system drafts the next reply rather than asking them to log activity.
Eliminating pipeline stages entirely will not hurt forecast quality for <5-person teams.

risks.statement: Inbox read permission + BYOK key together is a high-trust ask that may halve top-of-funnel conversion.
